title: Proofs of concept for privacy-preserving e-ID
description: Proofs of concept for privacy-preserving e-ID: BBS signatures with Bulletproofs (docknetwork/crypto) and Noir/UltraHONK circuits for holder binding, unlinkability, predicate proofs and revocation, with benchmarks on desktop and Android. The benchmarks are the basis of the MS2 report of the grant.
notes: Funded by Innosuisse, grant 101.292 IP-ICT "Secure and Privacy-Preserving Credentials for E-ID", a collaboration between EPFL / C4DT and SICPA SA. Research / demo code, not for production use.
